name: Special Meeting of the Beautification and Maintenance Commission
agenda_text:
CITY OF ARTESIA

  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE
  BEAUTIFICATION AND MAINTENANCE COMMISSION

  LOCATION
  ALBERT O. LITTLE COMMUNITY CENTER WESTSIDE
  18750 CLARKDALE AVENUE
  (562) 865-6262

  DATE
  THURSDAY SEPTEMBER 29, 2022
  5:00 P.M.

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

SPECIAL PROCEDURES

In order to reduce the risk of spreading coronavirus (COVID-19) and pursuant to the
Governor’s Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20, public observation and participation
will be facilitated by the following means:

Members of the public may observe and provide public comments in-person in the Albert
O. Little Community Center subject to posted COVID-19 protocols. Public comments
may also be submitted by email at publiccomments@cityofartesia.us or by leaving a
voicemail at (562) 865-6262, extension 200. Comment submitted before 4:00 p.m. on
the date of the meeting will be read until the time limit of three minutes has been reached.

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING PUBLIC COMMENTS
Public comments received prior to the commencement of the meeting will be read at this
time. Any public comments that cannot be heard within the next 20 minutes will be heard
at the end of the meeting. If a member of the public submitted public comments on an
item on the agenda, the public comment will be read at that time. Under the provisions
of the Brown Act, the Beautification and Maintenance Commission is prohibited from
taking action on items that are not listed on the agenda, but may refer the matter to staff
or to a subsequent meeting.

  1
 OLD BUSINESS

  1. Adopt the minutes from the following meeting: May 18, 2022

NEW BUSINESS

  2. Discuss the proposed City of Artesia Tree Protection Ordinance and
  recommend forwarding to the City Council for adoption

PUBLIC WORKS MANAGER AND/OR DEPUTY CITY MANAGER COMMENTS

COMMISSIONERS COMMENTS

  Adjournment to the next Regular Beautification and Maintenance Commission
  Meeting to be held on Thursday, October 20, 2022, at 6:00 P.M.

The City of Artesia complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please
contact City Hall at (562) 865-6262 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
